title: Closed launcher output pipes cause an EPIPE logging loop and prevent quit
prompt: Launch Electron through a wrapper, close the wrapper output pipes and then quit the app.

assertions.requiredBehavior: Handle EPIPE and ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED without recursively writing to broken streams; retain normal handling of unexpected stream errors.
